title: Li<sup>+</sup>-locked domain effect for breaking the temperature stability bottleneck in thermal-detection high-entropy energy storage ceramics
abstract: Published online: 01 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-79179-0 Dielectric energy-storage ceramics lose polarization at high temperatures, limiting harsh-environment use. Here, the authors show a Li+- locked domain effect in high-entropy BNT-based ceramics, achieving Wrec = 11.43 J cm−3, η = 84.67%, Δη/η < 0.3% up to 320 °C, with self-diagnostic thermometry.

title: Stabilizing silicon-sulfur cells via binder-free xerogel-silicon anode and interfacial network engineering
abstract: Published online: 31 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s43246-026-01416-2 Silicon offers high theoretical capacity for next-generation battery anodes, but volume expansion and interfacial instability hinder practical application. Here, the authors report a conductive poly(N-phenylglycine) xerogel-based silicon anode that enables stable, high-energy-density silicon-sulfur batteries.
